verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right order: logo and product, then headline, badges, CTA and legal. Its flaws are that the SUNSET SALE ribbon is jammed against the logo wordmark, the body copy is too small to read, the badge pills are tiny, and the legal block on the right is as heavy as the CTA. B is broken: the headline runs five lines and fills the left third, the CTA sits before the logo, the logo, product and badges are shrunk to specks and scattered, the body and legal text are microscopic single lines, the ribbon collides with the badges, and a missing-image placeholder is visible at the right edge.
